title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: built-in filter for temporary file noise on endpoints
summary: Hold: Global exclusions is not the only documented exclusion setting for tuning Insider Risk Management noise; Microsoft also documents exclusions in indicator variants. The roadmap dates and existing portal path are supported, and searches found no published default or dedicated control for the planned temporary-file filter.

claims.claim: Global exclusions is reached in Microsoft Purview portal through Settings > Insider Risk Management > Insider risk settings > Global exclusions.
claims.quote:
Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page, then select Insider Risk Management to go to the Insider Risk Management settings.
Under Insider risk settings, select Global exclusions.
claims.fix: The route correctly reaches the exclusions page but stops before an individual control. Keep it and expand the note with: 'For individual entries, select File paths > Individual file paths > Add file paths to exclude; File types > Individual file types > Add file type; or Keywords > Individual keywords > Exclude these keywords.' These routes are given at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-settings-global-exclusions.

claims.claim: Keyword exclusions can suppress activities involving matching file names, file paths or email subjects.
claims.quote: You can configure exclusions for keywords that appear in file names, file paths, or email message subject lines.

claims.claim: File-path exclusions suppress policy alerts for corresponding indicator activities in those locations.
claims.quote: When you exclude file paths, user activities that map to specific indicators and that occur in those file path locations don't generate policy alerts.
